rows.en:
(Am I really ready to join S.M.S.
and put my life on the line in battle...?)
rows.notes: Male player, the night before facing Ozma.

rows.en: Looks like you've made up your mind.
rows.notes: Ozma to the player; shared male/female.

rows.en: Please... Please let me join S.M.S.!!

We're a private military provider. When one of us
dies, it isn't 'killed in action.'
It gets written off as an accident.
rows.notes: Minkan gunji provider = private military provider.

rows.en:
There's no fleet-wide funeral, and not even
your own family gets told what really happened...

...Report to the barracks as a trainee
by 0800 tomorrow morning.
Understood! Ozma-san!
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Player still calls him Ozma-san; he corrects it next row.

rows.en: Heh. Starting tomorrow, it's Major Ozma.

Starting tomorrow, I'm gonna drill you
into the ground. Better brace yourself.
Go easy on me, okay, Michel?

(Starting tomorrow, I'm part of S.M.S. too...
I'm going to fight to protect Frontier!)

(Am I really ready to join S.M.S.
and put my life on the line in battle...?)
Please... Please let me join S.M.S.!!
Go easy on me, okay, Michel-kun?

(Starting tomorrow, I'm a member of S.M.S. too...
I'll fight to protect Frontier as well!)

This is Ozma.
We're holding your final enlistment test, starting now.
rows.notes: Phone call to the player; shared male/female.

rows.en:
It's an emergency call-up. You don't get to refuse.
Get to the Macross Quarter immediately.
Oh, there you are.

I never expected the final test
to be sprung on me out of nowhere.

Hey, don't get so worked up.
Just do what you always do, and you'll pass.

That's right. Good luck out there,
\p-san.
Yeah, thanks, Luca.
All right, let's head out.
(I'm passing this, no matter what!)

I never expected the final test
to be sprung on me out of nowhere.
Yeah, thank you, Luca-kun.
(I'm going to pass this, no matter what!)

Don't get down, \p.
Your moves weren't half bad.
rows.notes: Klan, after the player loses the mock battle.

rows.en:
Not bad at all,
\p.
rows.notes: Klan, after the player wins the mock battle.

rows.en:
...Wait, my opponent in the mock battle
was you, Klan-senpai!?

Actually, before that...
you're in S.M.S. too...?
rows.notes: Shozoku shiteta-n desu ne: surprise at learning she belongs to S.M.S.

rows.en: Hm? Come to think of it, I never told you, did I?

I am Captain Klan Klang,
leader of the S.M.S. Pixie Team.
rows.notes: Pixie shoutai = 'Pixie Team' per glossary; taii = Captain.

rows.en:
Judging by your skills today,
you've got pretty good instincts.
Keep at it, boy.
rows.notes: Male version; Klan calls him shounen ('boy'). Female version c24010 drops it.

rows.en: (So Klan-senpai was in S.M.S. too...)
We welcome you as an official member of S.M.S.!
rows.notes: Ends Ozma's announcement begun in c20799 ('As of this moment, you...', slice 290, not yet translated). Written as a full sentence so it stands whatever c20799 becomes; the subject 'we' (S.M.S.) is restored.

rows.en: You did it, \p.

Congratulations,
\p-san.
Thanks, Michel, Luca.
Not bad, \p.
Thanks to you too, Alto...
...Wait, Alto, what are you doing in S.M.S.!?
rows.notes: Japanese names Alto in the third person; he is right there, so addressed directly. Michel answers next.

rows.en:
This guy officially joined S.M.S.
just the other day, too.

All right! We're off to Nyan-Nyan to celebrate
you passing! We'll be drinking till dawn,
so get ready!
rows.notes: Ozma; kakugo shite oke = brace yourself.

rows.en: Captain Ozma, we're still minors, so...
rows.notes: Luca. Ozma-taichou = 'Captain Ozma' per glossary (taichou, decided 2026-10-17); the rank shousa stays 'Major'.

rows.en: Tch, that's right...
Whatever. Either way, we're partying tonight!

(Now I've officially been accepted
as a member of S.M.S.)

Judging by your skills today,
you've got pretty good instincts.
Keep at it.
(So Klan-senpai was in S.M.S. too...)
Thank you, Michel-kun, Luca-kun.
Thank you too, Saotome-kun...

...Wait, Saotome-kun, what are you doing
in S.M.S.!?

(Now I've officially been accepted
as a member of S.M.S.)

Hey, \p...
I know you're anxious, but calm down a little.

We're going to rescue the surviving Galaxy ships.
In the state you're in, you won't even save
the ones who could be saved.
rows.notes: Zanzonkan = the surviving ships (of the Galaxy fleet), as in mission text u2995.

rows.en: Michel... I know, but......

(The surviving ships that contacted us
are still under attack from the Vajra, too...)
rows.notes: Source closes the bracket with a half-width ')'; plain parentheses either way.

rows.en:
We'll be meeting up with the surviving ships shortly.
Pilots, stand by!
Huh!? Cathy-san?

Why, if it isn't \p-kun.
So you joined S.M.S.

As of today, I've been assigned
to S.M.S. as an observer.
I look forward to working with you.
Likewise, I look forward to working with you.

\p!
Save the greetings for after we get back!
S-sorry! Major Ozma!

Skull Leader to all units. Listen up,
I'm not letting a single one of you die.
We're all coming home to Frontier alive!
All right! Let's move out!
Michel-kun... I know, but......

Why, if it isn't \p-san.
So you joined S.M.S.

(We couldn't rescue every one
of the surviving Galaxy ships...)

Seems Alto and the others made it out
of the enemy ship safely, too.

Geez, those guys... Once their injuries heal,
looks like I'll have to retrain them from scratch.

You did good work out there.
Now, let's head back to Frontier.

(Looks like the mission was a success,
but I wasn't much help...)

(We couldn't rescue every one
of the surviving Galaxy ships...)

uncertain: c23997: completes Ozma's c20799 (slice 290, untranslated); written as a standalone sentence.
